purpose: Explicit storage/egress/retention posture for the Cloudflare R2 evidence buckets. This record IS the posture data: scripts/deployment/r2-posture-probe.ts (SigV4, zero-dependency) loads it and verifies the live buckets against it when credentials are present; without credentials it reports credential-gated and executes nothing. Secret hygiene: env NAMES, bucket names and endpoint facts only — never key values.

binding.vaultPosture: S3 access keys live only in the operator vault; the hosting plane holds them in its encrypted env store (runtime-plane-probe.json projectEnvKeys records the NAMES OBJECT_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY_ID / OBJECT_STORAGE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY)
binding.noSdkLaw: the probe signs SigV4 with node:crypto directly (the same zero-dependency pattern as scripts/deployment/runtime-plane-probe.ts) — no AWS SDK dependency is added (free/low-cost bias + no unexpected dependency)

providerFreeTierCeiling.egress: zero egress fees (R2's contractual differentiator — bandwidth out is never billed)
providerFreeTierCeiling.source: provider-documented free tier, cross-checked against public Cloudflare pricing references on 2026-10-02; live confirmation via the Cloudflare console is CREDENTIAL-GATED until the operator vault is re-supplied
providerFreeTierCeiling.headroomPolicy: self-imposed budgets keep >= 90% headroom below the storage ceiling for the evidence workload (early-stage posture)

selfImposedBudgets.notes: 1 GB total across both buckets (10% of the free-tier storage); writes/lists (Class A) budgeted at 10% of ceiling, reads (Class B) at 5%; evidence is write-once/read-rare so Class B stays near zero

buckets.name: payswap-evidence-prod
buckets.purpose: immutable, content-addressed evidence artifacts for the PRODUCTION plane (rail/provider execution evidence, reconciliation records, probe artifacts) — NOT financial truth (topology section 4: object storage holds evidence, the ledger is PostgreSQL)
buckets.storageClass: Standard (R2's only hot class; no infrequent-access/archive tiering is used)

prefixLayout.evidence/: protocol evidence artifacts (INV-E02 execution evidence, content-addressed)

retentionPolicy.policy: INDEFINITE RETENTION — required by INV-E05 (historical evidence is immutable): evidence artifacts may not be deleted or expired by a lifecycle rule; deletion is a governance decision (ADR) only

lifecycleRules.rule: abort incomplete multipart uploads after 7 days
lifecycleRules.rationale: hygiene only — reclaims bytes from interrupted uploads; deletes no complete object
lifecycleRules.status: required posture; application is credential-gated (Cloudflare API/console), not executed

egressExpectations.expected: near-zero — evidence is written by worker roles and read by authorized verification only; no public serving from R2
egressExpectations.costPosture: zero egress fees by provider contract; the risk surface is operations, not bandwidth

buckets.separationLaw: PRODUCTION bucket only — preview artifacts must never land here (the probe driver asserts prefix hygiene per bucket)

buckets.name: payswap-evidence-preview
buckets.purpose: evidence artifacts for the PREVIEW plane (preview deployments, drills, transient verification)

retentionPolicy.policy: PROPOSED: delete objects after 30 days (preview evidence is transient; the preview bucket is not a system of record). PENDING TL APPROVAL — until approved and applied, retention is indefinite and honestly recorded as such; no rule deletes anything today

lifecycleRules.rule: abort incomplete multipart uploads after 1 day
lifecycleRules.status: required posture; application is credential-gated, not executed

lifecycleRules.rule: delete objects after 30 days (prefix: entire bucket)
lifecycleRules.rationale: preview artifacts are transient; keeps the free tier uncluttered
lifecycleRules.status: PROPOSED — pending TL approval; NOT applied; not enforceable against INV-E05 (preview evidence is not historical protocol evidence)

egressExpectations.costPosture: zero egress fees by provider contract

buckets.separationLaw: PREVIEW bucket only — production artifacts must never land here

lifecycleManagementPlane: R2 lifecycle rules are managed via the Cloudflare API/console, NOT the S3 API (the S3-compatible surface supports object operations; GetBucketLifecycleConfiguration may answer NotImplemented). The probe driver ATTEMPTS the S3 lifecycle read and records the honest answer; rule APPLICATION requires the Cloudflare plane (credential-gated, recorded, never faked).

verification.gatedBehavior: without credentials the driver prints and (with --record) writes an honest credential-gated verification record and exits 0 — no live reading is fabricated
liveChecks: ListBuckets — both expected buckets exist; no unexpected third bucket
ListObjectsV2 (bounded pages) per bucket — object count + total size vs the storage budget
prefix hygiene — only declared prefixes (probe/, evidence/) present
GetBucketLifecycleConfiguration attempted per bucket — honest classification of the answer (rules / not-configured / not-supported-via-s3)
verification.lastExecution: credential-gated, not executed (operator vault lost to sandbox reset 2026-10-02; the last live R2 round trip is the activation probe in spec/development-state/runtime-plane-probe.json — digest-verified PUT+GET on payswap-evidence-prod)
